places.quote: The miserable man whom he had released for the time, but not for long, went on towards London.
places.note: Bradley is heading towards London but has not yet arrived in this passage.

places.normalized: The Temple (Inner and Middle Temple), London
places.quote: You know that I took you with me to his chambers in the Temple when I told him my opinion of him
places.note: Inn of Court area; Wrayburn's chambers are there. Could be treated as district.
